review_comments.body: `aws.region` is set JVM-wide and never cleared. Test classes run concurrently, so `ChatCompletionTest`'s Bedrock invalid-key test can then resolve a region and get a 403 instead of the "Unable to load region" error it asserts. Only the accept test needs a region, so please set it there and restore the previous value in `finally`, as `OciGenAITest` does.
Please also add to the `thinkingBudgetTokens` description in `ChatConfiguration` that `maxToken` must be greater than it on Anthropic and Amazon Bedrock, or the task fails.
